common.indicativePrices: Prices are indicative and confirmed by customer care before payment.

footer.noPayment: No payment is taken on this website. Every booking is confirmed and paid with our customer care team.

cookies.title: Cookies on Fareway
cookies.body: We only use essential cookies to remember your currency, language and theme, and to keep staff signed in. No advertising or tracking cookies.

hotels.title: Hotels are coming soon
hotels.body: We are starting with flights. Hotel search will join Fareway later.

cars.title: Car hire is coming soon
cars.body: We are starting with flights. Car hire search will join Fareway later.

home.title: Find the cheapest way to fly
home.subtitle: Compare flights to and from every country in the world. Choose your flight and our customer care team confirms the price and completes your booking with you.
home.exploreBody: See the cheapest places to fly from your nearest airport, filtered by continent, budget, month and flight time.

global.title: Every country covered
global.body: Search 250 countries and territories and thousands of airports, including places without their own airport.

people.title: Real people, not checkout pages
people.body: You never pay on this website. Our customer care team confirms availability and the final price before you pay.

honest.title: No fake urgency
honest.body: No countdown timers, no “only 2 seats left” tricks. Prices are shown as indicative, and we tell you why.

home.howTitle: Four steps from search to boarding pass

search.title: Search and compare
search.body: Find a flight that suits you by price, duration and stops.

request.title: Send a request
request.body: Add passenger details. You get a reference number straight away, with no payment taken.

contact.title: Talk to customer care
contact.body: Contact us by WhatsApp, phone or email with your reference. We confirm the price and availability.

pay.title: Pay and fly
pay.body: You pay through customer care. Your booking is confirmed only once payment is complete.

home.howNote: Requests are held for 48 hours. If we have not heard from you by then, the request expires and you can simply search again.

deals.indicative: Indicative return prices per adult in economy. Your exact price is confirmed by customer care before you pay.
